# Collapse filters

Status: **Built** · Section: Material Design 3, appearance, and layout · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

src/ui/main.ts History fold (`#hf-toggle`, `filtersCollapsed`, active-filter note)

## What is missing

nothing. Every screen that has a row of filters folds it; the app has no statistics panel with filters, and the site has no filter rows at all. (History, Activity, Extensions and Changelog fold; on Extensions the switch-off button stays in view.)
